title: Community, Environment, and Development, B.S. — Community and Economic Development Option (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: Fetched the raw archived 2023-24 bulletin HTML at the source URL below. Same course list and same per-term credit subtotals as the 2024-2026 editions (verified the printed Fall/Spring subtotals sum correctly to each page's own totals), but with two real, confirmed differences from those later editions: (1) this edition's Gen Ed items are generic, un-domain-tagged 'General Education Course' entries throughout (no GH/IL/Exploration/GN/GA domain labels -- those specific Knowledge Domain/Integrative Studies tags first appear starting with the 2024-25 edition; only the GHW-tagged Health & Wellness slots are tagged the same way in every edition) -- modeled here as untagged 'GEN ED' slots rather than guessing a domain that the bulletin itself didn't assign that year; (2) the Third Year row order is swapped relative to 2024-2026: this edition's Third Year Fall has 'PLSC 1, 3, or 14' (not CED 327) and Third Year Spring has 'CED 327' (not PLSC), the reverse of the 2024-2026 arrangement -- confirmed by direct row-by-row comparison of the fetched raw HTML tables, not assumed. Also lists 'CAS 100' (unsectioned) as a fourth valid alternative to CAS 100A/100B/100C in Semester 4, which the 2024-2026 editions drop -- added as a trailing 4th option (CAS 100 is a real, printed alternative on this edition's own bulletin table but isn't in the local cas_catalog.json cache, so it's listed after the three cached CAS 100A/100B/100C sections, the same practical-workaround convention CED-2026.json already uses for BLAW 425). Reproduced the same shared-catalog hidden-prereq fixes as CED-2026.json/2024/2025 (AEE 360 before AEE 460 in Semester 5, added to the Fall slot vacated by moving CED 327 out of Fall for this edition's own real Fall/Spring split; MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 before STAT 200, Semesters 1-3) since these come from the shared, year-invariant course catalog, not from bulletin text, and are real regardless of catalog year.
